                    ### Question
                    A child with which of the following diseases would have the highest morbidity from being outside during a hot summer day?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Tay-Sachs disease
opb. Cystic fibrosis

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Cystic fibrosis and asthma both pose risks for increased morbidity on a hot summer day. Cystic fibrosis can lead to heat exhaustion due to sweat gland dysfunction and higher susceptibility to dehydration. Asthma can exacerbate symptoms in hot weather, increasing the risk of respiratory distress. Both conditions can result in higher morbidity when exposed to hot weather.
